question: Does a fresh 15-minute close recross of EMA5, conditioned on ordered EMA5/21/55 trend, provide a materially distinct and friction-positive continuation mechanism on BTC and SOL?
why_now: The active V57 routes have not yet produced a lifecycle, so exact live collection remains the highest-value investigation but cannot be accelerated honestly.
The prior SOL failed-range-reclaim family was negative in development, validation, and nearly every pseudo-holdout cell, so changing only its range lookback is not a distinct hypothesis.
Repository prior-art search did not find this exact EMA5 recross plus EMA21/55 ordering mechanism.

frozen_scope.signal_ohlc_source: canonical public-trade 5m bars aggregated only from three complete child bars
frozen_scope.execution_quote_source: first exact public L2 bid/ask in the next 15m bar

frozen_signal.long_entry: fresh completed-close cross from at-or-below EMA5 to above EMA5 while EMA5 > EMA21 > EMA55
frozen_signal.short_entry: fresh completed-close cross from at-or-above EMA5 to below EMA5 while EMA5 < EMA21 < EMA55
frozen_signal.fill: next 15m bar first exact executable ask for long or bid for short
frozen_signal.long_exit: first completed close below EMA5, executed at the next bar first bid
frozen_signal.short_exit: first completed close above EMA5, executed at the next bar first ask

frozen_economics.funding: exact verified hourly funding when available

technical_path_contract.l2_bar_complete_when: at least two snapshots and first-boundary, maximum-internal, and end-boundary gaps are each <=15 seconds
technical_path_contract.missing_or_incomplete_signal_or_fill_bar: censor the affected decision or lifecycle and report it
technical_path_contract.mark_path: exact historical venue mark path is not currently proven for this interval
technical_path_contract.qualification_effect: economic results remain development diagnostics and cannot support promotion while any selected lifecycle liquidation or stop path is unresolved

predeclared_reporting: nominal and stress net PnL, return, profit factor, drawdown, fees, funding, and liquidations
trade count and trades per week by symbol, side, fold, and pooled portfolio
largest-winner removal by symbol, side, fold, and pooled portfolio
conflicting signals, rejected fills, gap-censored decisions, and unresolved lifecycle counts
common-time portfolio concurrency and margin utilization
exact input hashes, row counts, window bounds, and generator identity
development_acceptance_for_opening_valid: pooled nominal and stress net PnL are positive
pooled nominal and stress profit factor exceed 1.0
pooled stress net PnL excluding the largest winner is positive
all three development folds are stress-positive
both long and short stress net PnL are positive
no unresolved selected-lifecycle execution or risk path
bias_controls: No parameter grid is authorized for this hypothesis.
No validation or holdout rows may influence parameters, selection, or development disposition.
Results will be compared with rejection and with leaving V57 unchanged; a positive result is not live authorization.
The external research suggestion is treated only as hypothesis generation; its cadence and profitability claims are not evidence.
failure_modes: EMA recross whipsaw after fees and spread
trend ordering is late and captures exhaustion rather than continuation
one side or one winner carries pooled results
data gaps or absent mark history prevent technical qualification
BTC and SOL co-trigger and concentrate directional risk
falsifiers: The exact mechanism already exists in repository evidence and was previously rejected.
Any frozen input, parameter, bound, or acceptance rule changes after reading results.
Development economics fail any predeclared acceptance condition.
The technical path cannot be resolved without synthetic prices.

priority.higher_ranked_investigation: Collect exact both-side HYPE V57 live execution lifecycles.
priority.reason: The HYPE route is already live and source-compatible; this candidate can progress in parallel without changing live authority.
